turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I need a refill of my lisinopril. I have about a week left.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: You are on lisinopril 10 mg once daily, correct?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any dizziness or cough since we started it?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: I will send a 90 day supply to your pharmacy.
